cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Freelander 2.5 V6 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
